seed_policy.repetitions_1_to_20: Reuse the immutable original trajectory triplets and their observation-noise seeds (trajectory seed + 1000000).
seed_policy.repetitions_21_to_100: Reuse the immutable M17 extension trajectory triplets and their observation-noise seeds (trajectory seed + 10000000).
seed_policy.common_noise_across_levels: Within each repetition and split, use the same standard-normal observation draw at every positive sigma_obs value.

fixed_conditions: Preserve M=17, N=1000, T=2, dt=0.005, sigma=0.1, the true kernel, initial law, 25x8 fixed weak tests, exact full pairs, trapezoidal quadrature, 1/sqrt(200) row scaling, raw cyclic LASSO and independent-validation selection. Only sigma_obs changes.
stopping_rule: Run all 100 predeclared repetitions at all four added values, irrespective of monotonicity or intermediate results. Do not add, remove or select seeds based on outcomes.
failure_policy: Retain every failed job, unconverged candidate, boundary selection, divergent rollout and basis-domain excursion. If any planned metric is missing, report the all-repetition mean and interval as null.
plotting: Connect zero and positive values on a symlog horizontal axis with linthresh=0.0003. Use a logarithmic vertical axis only for positive metrics and place explicit numerical tick labels within every panel's displayed range.
manuscript_instruction: Do not edit the manuscript in this stage. Preserve the instruction to present M=17 only in later manuscript work.
